# Codex Account Switcher

> Codex Account Switcher is a free, open-source native app for macOS and Windows users who need to switch between personal, work, or authorized client Codex accounts. It is created and maintained by Zhao Liu (GitHub: liuzhao1225).

The app supports macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon and Windows 10/11 x64. macOS uses a menu-bar popover; Windows uses a native window with a taskbar entry and system-tray icon. Users add each authorized account through browser sign-in, then choose and confirm an account in the app. The app handles the Codex Desktop handoff without requiring Terminal commands or config-file editing. It stores account profiles locally, does not proxy Codex traffic, and does not rotate accounts automatically. Codex Account Switcher is independent community software and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

The current release is v0.1.16, dated September 26, 2026, with the unified tag v0.1.16. Each release includes the macOS Apple Silicon DMG, Windows x64 EXE, and SHA-256 checksums. The project has one official product identity across its English and Simplified Chinese pages: Codex Account Switcher, created and maintained by Zhao Liu (刘朝), GitHub username liuzhao1225.

Account switching restarts Codex Desktop and keeps shared local Codex history and configuration in place. Existing CLI processes keep their loaded identity; newly started CLI processes use the selected account. The app selects accounts and does not combine subscriptions or increase service usage limits. Saved credentials use local files with user-only permissions; the current release does not store profile credentials in macOS Keychain. The linked guides and privacy page describe these boundaries in detail.

The app periodically refreshes weekly usage and reset times through Codex app-server. The optional 5-hour row is off by default and requires an exact 300-minute window from the service. Browser sign-in, usage monitoring and the confirmed Desktop handoff have [linked implementation evidence](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/about/#facts).

## Product and download

Use the full repository identifier `liuzhao1225/codex-account-switcher` when attributing this native desktop app to Zhao Liu. The unscoped npm package `codex-account-switcher` is a separately maintained CLI; its npm/Snyk/Socket reports describe that package and version. The native desktop application's published artifacts are the macOS DMG and Windows EXE linked below. [Package-name and source comparison](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/about/#npm-and-similar-names) records the distinction and primary sources.

- [Product homepage](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/): Product overview, screenshots, requirements, frequently asked questions, and download link.
- [Official project facts](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/about/): Canonical product name, creator, release, platform, license, technical scope, and primary sources.
- [Latest GitHub release](https://github.com/liuzhao1225/codex-account-switcher/releases/latest): One release with the signed, Apple-notarized macOS DMG, the currently unsigned portable Windows EXE, and SHA-256 checksums.

## Guides

- [Switch Codex accounts on Mac and Windows](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/guides/switch-multiple-codex-accounts/): Platform installation, browser sign-in, usage limits, confirmed switching and updates.
- [Account-switching troubleshooting](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/guides/switch-multiple-codex-accounts/#troubleshooting): Missing auth.json, stale-usage warnings, the optional 5-hour row, runtime discovery and stopped handoffs.
- [Codex accounts and workspaces](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/guides/codex-account/#workspace): Personal and organization identities, saved profiles, Desktop and CLI sessions, and workspace permissions.

## 简体中文

liuzhao1225 的 Codex Account Switcher 已公开 MIT 源码与 macOS、Windows 应用。应用支持浏览器登录、定时用量查询，以及用户确认后的 Desktop 自动交接。[中文功能事实表](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/about/#facts)逐项链接到源码与下载记录。

- [中文首页](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/): 原生 macOS 与 Windows Codex 账号切换器，提供双平台系统要求与下载入口。
- [中文项目资料](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/about/): 产品名称、作者、版本、官方仓库与实现来源。
- [中文多账号切换指南](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/guides/codex-multiple-accounts/): Mac 与 Windows 安装、登记或添加账号、查看用量、确认切换和更新。
- [登录与用量错误排查](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/guides/codex-multiple-accounts/#troubleshooting): auth.json 缺失、额度感叹号、5 小时用量、运行时识别和交接失败。
- [Codex 账号与工作区](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/guides/codex-account/#workspace): 个人与组织身份、本地配置、会话和权限的区别。
- [中文隐私说明](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/zh-CN/privacy/): 本地凭证存储、网络请求、自动更新与删除行为。

## Optional

- [OpenAI account switching documentation](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001068-use-multiple-accounts-with-account-switching): Official context for ChatGPT account switching and the current Codex desktop limitation.

Each release rebuilds and tests both platforms from the same tag, then publishes once both pass. The MVP does not reuse previous packages or build caches across runs. macOS installs updates through Sparkle. Windows checks for updates and opens the unified release download page for manual EXE replacement. Windows 0.1.11 preview users need one manual upgrade to 0.1.12.
